feedback.problem:
Given that the discrete random variable $X$ has the cumulative distribution function $F(x)$ shown in the table below, compute $P(X=6).$

| $x$ | $0$ | $2$ | $4$ | $6$ | $8$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $F(x)$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{3}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{2}$ | $\frac{7}{8}$ | $1$ |
feedback.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(6) & =P(X\le 6) \\  & =P(X\in {0,2,4,6}) \\  & =P(X=0)+P(X=2)+P(X=4)+P(X=6) \\  & =P(X\in {0,2,4})+P(X=6) \\  & =P(X\le 4)+P(X=6) \\  & =F(4)+P(X=6).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=6) & =F(6)-F(4) \\  & =\frac{7}{8}-\frac{1}{2} \\  & =\frac{3}{8}.\end{aligned}
$$
